<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court scrutiny:</strong> The Supreme Court is currently examining the Shiv Sena symbol dispute, specifically questioning whether a split within a legislative party can automatically reflect a split in the parent political party.</li>
  <li><strong>Delimitation concerns:</strong> The Tamil Nadu Assembly has passed a resolution urging the Union government to freeze the number of Lok Sabha seats at 543 and implement the 33% women’s reservation quota based on existing constituency boundaries.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
